::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 15th 1901  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Reading University Library 1448/120
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)
I see you are advertising [Highways and Byways in Spain](other_books/otherbook_780.qmd).  I should be much obliged if I might have a copy as my [Sister in law](people/person_1604.qmd) and her daughters are at Algeciras, where the [husband](people/person_386.qmd) of [one](people/person_388.qmd) is Vice Consul.  I am expecting the [elder one](people/person_1613.qmd) to return before the end of the month, and the book would be much enjoyed by us together.

I am glad [Modern Broods](cmy_books/cmybook_251.qmd) is doing well.  It is more than I expected, for I do not think I can attempt any more of the kind after a long spell of success.

yours sincerely
C M Yonge
